snippet.title: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi | Best Indie Games Summer Showcase Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638160/Altheia_The_Wrath_of_Aferi/

Classic, challenging, and creative. Altheia: Wrath of Aferi brings a fresh perspective to the classic action adventure. Use Lily and Sadi’s unique powers to explore, solve puzzles and defeat fearsome foes.
